Local Tastes
Kottu Roti
Chopped roti stir-fried with vegetables, egg, and meat on a hot griddle; the rhythmic clanging of the blades is the signature street-food sound of Colombo.
Pilawoos · 417 Galle Road
Egg Hoppers
Bowl-shaped rice flour crepes with a fried egg set in the center; eaten for breakfast with coconut sambol and seeni sambol.
Nuga Gama · Cinnamon Grand Hotel
Lamprais
A Dutch-Burgher legacy dish: rice, meat curry, frikkadels, and sambol baked together wrapped in a banana leaf; a direct artifact of Colombo's colonial heritage.
Dutch Burgher Union · Reid Avenue
Isso Vadei
Crispy lentil fritters topped with a whole prawn; sold by vendors along Galle Face Green every evening.
Vendors along Galle Face Green
Crab Curry
Whole crabs cooked in a rich, coconut-milk-based curry with roasted spices; a Colombo specialty most prominent at seafront restaurants.
Ministry of Crab · Old Dutch Hospital
King Coconut
The bright orange thambili coconut, sold chilled from roadside carts; sweeter and more electrolyte-rich than green coconut.
Roadside carts near Galle Face Green
Food Delivery
PickMe Food
Foreign number: accepted. — verification arrives by WhatsApp, so install it on that number first.
Sri Lanka's dominant food delivery platform; wide Colombo coverage from the Fort and Pettah through Colombo 3, 5, and 7; excellent selection of local rice-and-curry spots, kottu joints, and bakeries alongside international options.
pickme.lk
Uber Eats
Foreign number: accepted.
Available in Colombo with strong coverage in the Colombo 3 and Colombo 7 hotel and expat areas; better known restaurant selection including international chains; useful backup if PickMe Food is slow or unavailable for your area.
ubereats.com
Getting Around
PickMe
Foreign number: accepted. — verify via WhatsApp on your foreign number before arriving.
Sri Lanka's main ride-hailing app; comprehensive Colombo coverage from the Fort to Mount Lavinia; reliable for metered fares without negotiation — significantly more transparent than hailing tuk-tuks on the street for longer trips.
pickme.lk
Uber
Foreign number: accepted.
Available in Colombo and a reliable alternative to PickMe; coverage across central and southern Colombo; fares are comparable — check both apps for the better wait time, especially during evening rush hours.

Worth Knowing

Colonial Compression

Three days in Colombo are three walks through the same 400 meters of coastline that the Dutch, British, and Sri Lankans each claimed in turn. The hospital they built to trade, the parliament they built to govern, and the hotel their guests built to face the Indian Ocean are all still standing within five minutes of each other — none of them museums, all of them still in use.

That compression — Dutch colonial brick against Victorian stucco against a 19th-century grand hotel — is what makes the Fort district unlike any other colonial-era city center in South Asia.
